criteria: 能说出正弦是纵坐标、余弦是横坐标
能求 0°、30°、90° 的正弦或余弦

set.name: Definition of Trigonometric Functions

criteria: 能把公式用在 60° 与 30° 上
能把结果化成 1/2 这类值
set.description: 会用 sin(α−β)=sinα cosβ−cosα sinβ 计算可以化成特殊角的值。
set.name: Sine of the Difference of Two Angles

criteria: 能计算 sin(α+β) 在特殊角上的值
能区分和角与差角公式的符号
set.description: 会用和角公式计算能化成 0、±1/2、±1 的值。
set.name: Sine and Cosine of the Sum of Two Angles

criteria: 能计算平均数
能说明其含义
set.description: 理解平均数是反映一组数据集中趋势的统计量，会求算术平均数。
set.name: Mean

criteria: 能推导内角和公式
能用公式求边数或角度
set.description: n 边形内角和为 (n-2)×180°，可通过分割成三角形推导。
set.name: Sum of the Interior Angles of a Polygon

criteria: 能说出外心的性质
能确定直角三角形外心位置
set.description: 经过三角形三个顶点的圆叫外接圆，圆心是三边垂直平分线的交点，叫外心。
set.name: Circumcircle of a Triangle

criteria: 能指出底和对应的高
能用底×高求面积
set.description: 会用底乘高计算平行四边形的面积。
set.name: Area of a Parallelogram

criteria: 能按角给三角形分类
能说出等边三角形三条边都相等
set.description: 会按角把三角形分成锐角、直角、钝角三角形，按边认出等腰三角形和等边三角形。
set.name: Classifying triangles

set.reason: Interior angle sums help with angle work. However, radius and apothem come from the central angle 360/n and a right triangle, and the interior angle follows from the central angle too.
set.scope: angle facts of regular polygons

set.reason: The triangle circumcircle introduces circles through all vertices, which eases the generalization. Regular polygon center and radius can be defined via symmetry or equal division of a circle.
set.scope: circumscribed circle of a regular polygon

set.reason: A special trigonometric value is a value of the corresponding side ratio.
set.scope: meaning of special angle values

set.reason: Right-triangle ratios motivate the unit-circle definition and help compute sin 30°. The coordinate definition stands alone and covers non-acute angles that ratios cannot.
set.scope: motivating unit-circle definitions from right-triangle ratios

set.reason: One explicit criterion is to distinguish the signs of sum and difference formulas. That comparison requires the relevant difference formulas, even though a direct derivation of the sum formula alone could avoid them.
set.scope: Distinguishing the signs in the sine/cosine sum and difference formulas

set.reason: Triangle classification helps recognize where an altitude may lie. The area relation and a supplied base/height can be used across all triangle types without first sorting them as acute, right or obtuse.
set.scope: locating heights in right and obtuse triangles

set.reason: The target explicitly states that the triangle has half the area of an equal-base equal-height parallelogram. Parallelogram-area meaning is needed for that specified comparison.
set.scope: triangle as half a parallelogram

criteria: 能说出正多边形的相关量
能计算正多边形的半径与边心距
set.description: 正多边形有外接圆和内切圆，认识中心、半径、边心距、中心角，并作正多边形。
set.name: Regular Polygons and Circles

criteria: 能说出三角形面积是等底等高平行四边形的一半
能用底×高÷2 求面积
set.description: 会用底乘高除以 2 计算三角形的面积。
set.name: Area of a Triangle

set.reason: Interior angle sums help with angle work. However, radius and apothem come from the central angle 360/n and a right triangle, and the interior angle follows from the central angle too.
set.scope: angle facts of regular polygons

set.reason: The triangle circumcircle introduces circles through all vertices, which eases the generalization. Regular polygon center and radius can be defined via symmetry or equal division of a circle.
set.scope: circumscribed circle of a regular polygon

set.reason: A special trigonometric value is a value of the corresponding side ratio.
set.scope: meaning of special angle values

set.reason: Right-triangle ratios motivate the unit-circle definition and help compute sin 30°. The coordinate definition stands alone and covers non-acute angles that ratios cannot.
set.scope: motivating unit-circle definitions from right-triangle ratios

set.reason: One explicit criterion is to distinguish the signs of sum and difference formulas. That comparison requires the relevant difference formulas, even though a direct derivation of the sum formula alone could avoid them.
set.scope: Distinguishing the signs in the sine/cosine sum and difference formulas

set.reason: Triangle classification helps recognize where an altitude may lie. The area relation and a supplied base/height can be used across all triangle types without first sorting them as acute, right or obtuse.
set.scope: locating heights in right and obtuse triangles

set.reason: The target explicitly states that the triangle has half the area of an equal-base equal-height parallelogram. Parallelogram-area meaning is needed for that specified comparison.
set.scope: triangle as half a parallelogram
